tools.name: search_schools
tools.description: Find South Korean elementary, middle and high schools by name (Korean, partial names work: '상계고', '서울 대치초'). Returns eduCode and schoolCode needed by the other tools, plus school type, province and address.

tools.name: get_meals
tools.description: School meal menu (breakfast/lunch/dinner) for a day, this week, next week or this month, with calories, macronutrients and allergens per dish. Pass the user's allergies to flag dishes that contain them. No meals on weekends and school holidays.

tools.name: get_timetable
tools.description: Class timetable (period and subject) for a school, grade and class on a given day. Without grade/class it returns every class, so pass them when known.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: School academic calendar events (exams, vacations, holidays, field trips, ceremonies) between two dates. Defaults to the next 30 days.

tools.name: get_school_info
tools.description: Basic school information: Korean and English name, type, address, phone, fax, homepage, founding date, public/private, coeducational or not, and the supervising office of education. For high schools, also departments/tracks.

tools.name: search_academies
tools.description: Registered private academies (hagwon) and tutoring centers in a South Korean district, filtered by subject keyword, from the offices of education's registration data. Returns up to 15 with field, courses, address and phone. Data in Korean.
